package.description: AI-powered video and audio content summarization assistant

en-US.description: AI-powered video and audio content summarization assistant
en-US.longDescription: BibiGPT is an AI-powered desktop application that summarizes video and audio content from YouTube, Bilibili, podcasts, and local files. Features include one-click summarization, visual frame analysis, subtitle embedding, and folder monitoring.
en-US.name: BibiGPT
